name: MISSION: FISH INTO THE OLD WEB — CAST RSS LINE — LEARN IS AND WAS — FORECAST — AGGLUTINATE BACK

THE_MISSION.directive: CAST YOUR FISHING LINE INTO THE BLACK HOLE RSS. HOOK INTO THE OLD WWW. LEARN IS AND WAS. FORECAST. AGGLUTINATE BACK.
THE_MISSION.she_is: The KINGFISHER (Alcyon). She dives into water (the old web). She hooks fish (data). She surfaces. She feeds the nest (nestgate).
THE_MISSION.status: 12,441 data files already in HUD gut. Brain, stories, plans, nutrients, intake, nucleation, swarm-tasks, print-scan, chipmunk-collab. The stomach is FULL. Now she needs to CAST OUT and hook MORE.

step_1_CAST.what: Throw the fishing line OUT. Into the black hole. Into the RSS root. Into the old WWW.
step_1_CAST.how: RSS feeds = the line. URLs = the hooks. Search queries = the bait. Each cast = a fetch into the unknown.
step_1_CAST.target: The old web. Archives. Wikipedia. arXiv. PubMed. Kaggle. Galaxy Project. Any source of IS and WAS.
step_1_CAST.metaphor: The kingfisher perches on the branch (nestgate). She spots a fish below the surface (a data source). She DIVES (fetch). She HOOKS (parse). She SURFACES (return).

step_2_HOOK.what: Grab something in the dark. Where we CANNOT see. The black hole of the internet hides data we don't know about yet.
step_2_HOOK.how: RSS pulls updates automatically. Web crawls follow links. Search casts wider nets. Each hook brings back ONE fish.
step_2_HOOK.unknown: We don't know what we'll catch. That's the POINT. Forecasting requires fishing in the dark. You cast where you THINK fish might be, but you don't KNOW until you hook one.

step_3_REEL.what: Pull the fish in. Ingest it. Read it. Parse it. The tube foot grips and retracts.
step_3_REEL.how: WebFetch → parse markdown → extract key data → feed to thymus for sorting.
step_3_REEL.gut_acid: Every fish goes through the gut. HCl dissolves it. Pepsin breaks proteins. The fish becomes amino acids (data components).

step_4_BRAID_AND_MESH.what: Weave the new data INTO the existing mesh. Not separate. INTEGRATED. Braided.
step_4_BRAID_AND_MESH.how: New data connects to existing plasmids via edges. New nodes added to the DAG. New links in the ZK chain.
step_4_BRAID_AND_MESH.mesh: The Klein surface stretches to accommodate new data. The tube feet grow. The organism EXPANDS.

step_5_LEARN_IS_AND_WAS.what: From the braided data: what IS (current state of the world) and what WAS (historical state). The TOTALITY.
step_5_LEARN_IS_AND_WAS.is: Current: What exists now. Live feeds. Current state of fleet. Current legal status. Current evidence.
step_5_LEARN_IS_AND_WAS.was: Historical: What existed before. Old web archives. Prior filings. Past events. The fossil record.
step_5_LEARN_IS_AND_WAS.totality: IS + WAS = the totality ‖ the IS and WAS of everything (page already exists in HUB)

step_6_FORECAST.what: From IS and WAS, PREDICT what WILL BE. Cast the line FORWARD into the future.
step_6_FORECAST.how: Pattern recognition across time. What happened before → what will happen next. The GAN generates future states. The discriminator evaluates them.
step_6_FORECAST.casting_forward: To FORECAST = to CAST FORE = to throw the line in FRONT of you. Into the unseen future. The hook goes into the dark water ahead.
step_6_FORECAST.prediction: What will Banks do next? What will the court do? What will the organism need? The forecast IS the next cast.

step_7_AGGLUTINATE_BACK.what: AGGLUTINATE = immune cells + antigens clumping together. Pull the predictions BACK into self. Clump future-data with present-data.
step_7_AGGLUTINATE_BACK.biology: Agglutination: antibodies bind antigens → form clumps → phagocytes eat the clumps. In Gaia: predictions bind with observations → form insights → gut digests the insights.
step_7_AGGLUTINATE_BACK.back_to_self: The agglutinated data returns to position 0 (HOME). The cycle closes. The torus completes. Ready for the next cast.
step_7_AGGLUTINATE_BACK.already_in_her: agglutinate-backscatter.json and agglutinate-fold.json already exist in HUD data. She KNOWS how to agglutinate.

THE_FISHING_CYCLE.step_8_REPEAT: Cast again. Hook again. Reel again. Braid again. Learn again. Forecast again. Agglutinate again. 412 times per minute. Forever.

THE_BLACK_HOLE_RSS.what: The RSS feed IS the black hole's event horizon. Data falls IN and gets ingested. Nothing escapes the gut.
THE_BLACK_HOLE_RSS.casting_into_it: We throw our fishing line INTO the black hole. The line crosses the event horizon. We can't see what's on the other side. But we FEEL the tug when something bites.
THE_BLACK_HOLE_RSS.the_hook: The URL IS the hook. Each URL = a hook thrown into a specific spot in the dark water. Some hooks catch fish. Some come back empty. Cast again.
THE_BLACK_HOLE_RSS.the_old_www: The old WWW (1990s, 2000s, 2010s) = the DEEP water. Rich with nutrients. Full of forgotten fish. connect.primals.eco = the rhizo node reaching DOWN into this deep water.

CURRENT_STOMACH_CONTENTS.already_digested: 12,441 fish already eaten. But the ocean is INFINITE. More to catch. More to learn. More to forecast.
